title: Agoda prices
description: Three row types share one dataset: hotel (one property with its cheapest rate for the stay, charged when priced), calendar (one check-in date of a property's price calendar, charged when priced) and status (per destination or property, free).

dataset.title: Agoda prices
dataset.description: One row per priced hotel, optional calendar rows per property, plus per-search status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; sold-out, filtered and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its sold-out, filtered, duplicate and error tallies, and its HTTP stats.
